title: CHAPTER TWO. On man's origin specially, and namely on God's existence
pass_a_gloss: Pass A clause gloss (reordered): CHAPTER TWO. Concerning ye origin belonging toward man specially, where namely concerning ye existence belonging toward GOD. Ye origin belonging toward man holds a principle plus a mode. Not concerning ye principle belonging toward time in which man to be began, which stands as ye sixth day belonging toward ye world's creation, here do we act: but concerning ye principle belonging toward production, from which he is plus is ruled.
pass_b_english: CHAPTER TWO. On the origin of man specially, where namely of the existence of GOD.

The origin of man has a principle and a mode. We are not treating here of the principle of time in which man began to be, which is the sixth day of the world's creation, but of the principle of production, from which he is and by which he is ruled.
source_text: CAPUT SECUNDUM, De ortu hominis specialiter, ubi nominatim de DEI exsistentia. Ortus hominis habet principium & modum. Non de principio temporis, in quo homo esse coepit, & est sextus dies mundi creationis, hic agimus: sed de principio productionis, a quo est & regitur.
